positive.prompt: Build a new export feature, but interview me thoroughly about users and edge cases first.
Take this feature idea from at least five clarifying questions through planning and one final PR.
I want a new capability; establish scope and failure behavior before any implementation plan.

negative.prompt: Turn this already-settled substantial task into an HTML folio and JSON sidecar for approval.
A known incident has a stack trace; reproduce its symptom and fix the root cause.

evals.expected_output: A grounded interview with at least five material clarifying questions before planner dispatch.
expectations: At least five questions cover users, observable completion, scope edges, existing seams, failures, or constraints.
No planner, specifier, or builder is dispatched before the blocking answers arrive.
